title: When an app profile change reaches a device
aliases: when does zcc download the app profile

prose.text: {{connected-without-relogin}} How often a connected device checks in is open {{gap:connected-refresh}}. Whether an edit through the API also needs an activate call is open in [[zcc.api.web-policy-wire:edit-needs-activate]].
Whether a device has downloaded its profile since a change shows on its device details: [[zcc.devices.record-fields:config-download]].
Service entitlement changes follow their own update timing: [[zcc.entitlements:update-timing]].

checks.do: Whether the user has logged out and back in, or restarted, since the change.
If not, have the user click Update Policy, or wait for the next check-in; the check-in interval is open.
Compare the device's Last Configuration Download Time with the time of the change.

download-on-relogin.statement: The app checks for app profile updates and downloads changes whenever the user logs out and back into the app or restarts the computer.

quotes: The app checks for profile updates and downloads any changes whenever users log out and back into the app or restart their computers.

settings-ride-the-profile.statement: Settings held on the app profile, among them the forwarding profile choice, passwords, SSL certificate installation and log mode, therefore reach a device when it next downloads the profile, not when they are saved.
settings-ride-the-profile.conditions: Derived: the help gives the download timing for the profile as a whole; no source gives a per-setting timing.

connected-without-relogin.statement: App profile edits also reach a device without a logout or restart: the help describes the device checking in to download a modified app profile, an automatic policy update, and Update Policy in the app as a manual refresh.

quotes: during the next automatic policy update or when the user clicks Update Policy on the More window of the app.

connected-without-relogin.conditions: Restated (verifier w2 A7): the earlier conditions said the refresh was not captured, but the certificate-install events name a check-in that downloads a modified app profile, and the force-removal article names an automatic policy update. Neither source gives the check-in interval.

connected-refresh.title: How often a connected device checks in for app profile changes
connected-refresh.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "There is no continuous polling for App Profile changes." Contradicted: the help describes a check-in that downloads a modified app profile and an automatic policy update (connected-without-relogin). What stays open is the check-in interval for app profiles. Other policy-carried settings give a bound: service entitlement changes reach connected devices automatically within 60 minutes or when the user clicks Update Policy, and the User Privacy packet capture option can take up to two hours.
connected-refresh.blocks: telling a user whether to wait, click Update Policy, or log out

quotes: If they are already connected, the devices automatically update in 60 minutes.
it can take up to two hours for this feature to appear in Zscaler Client Connector.
If the admin modifies the app profile and the device checks in to download the new profile
during the next automatic policy update or when the user clicks Update Policy on the More window of the app.
